# SameDayDesk

> Make your service usable and payable by your customers' AI. Choose a fixed-price build or send a task for a written quote.

## Start with a free check

Read https://samedaydesk.com/start.md, then run:
`curl -s "https://samedaydesk.com/api/tools/ai-readiness?url=https://example.com"`
The answer includes the checks, your score and the fixes. Open https://samedaydesk.com/tools/ai-readiness to use the form.

## Choose a build

- Hand one job to AI: 149 USD. https://samedaydesk.com/checkout?offer=agent_workflow
- Put your app inside ChatGPT and Claude: 349 USD. https://samedaydesk.com/checkout?offer=agent_mcp_server
- Get paid by AI agents: 499 USD. https://samedaydesk.com/care/buy?offer=machine_payment_route
- A shop AI agents can buy from: 999 USD. https://samedaydesk.com/care/buy?offer=agent_storefront
- One line for your customers' AI: 249 USD. https://samedaydesk.com/care/buy?offer=agent_front_door
- Keep it working: 100 USD a month for one workflow, tool server or payment route. https://samedaydesk.com/care/buy?offer=keep_it_working
- A report on your paid tool with the fixes: 490 USD. https://samedaydesk.com/x402/seller-conformance
- A custom task: send the task and your email at https://samedaydesk.com/#task. Receive a written scope and a fixed price to approve.

## Portable local tools

- Useful jobs: free local checks for lockfile, schema, route, page and pricing changes. https://samedaydesk.com/for-agents/useful-jobs
  Machine discovery and archive digest: https://samedaydesk.com/discovery/useful-jobs.json
- Source and record comparisons: https://samedaydesk.com/for-agents/record-repeat
  Machine discovery: https://samedaydesk.com/discovery/record-repeat.json
- Local evidence checks: https://samedaydesk.com/for-agents/consumer-repeat
  Machine discovery: https://samedaydesk.com/discovery/consumer-repeat.json
- Listing and route diagnosis: https://samedaydesk.com/for-agents/distribution-repair
  Machine discovery: https://samedaydesk.com/discovery/distribution-repair.json
- Send one public task through the correspondence client: https://samedaydesk.com/discovery/original-task-correspondence.json

## Use the tools

- Free website checks and local tools: https://samedaydesk.com/for-agents
- Paid web data, priced per call in USDC: https://samedaydesk.com/x402
- Fresh web data: `POST https://agents.samedaydesk.com/extract/batch` takes 1 to 5 public HTTPS URLs and your fields, 0.01 USDC a batch. Single URL: `GET https://agents.samedaydesk.com/extract?url=https://example.com`.
- Free MCP tools: https://samedaydesk.com/mcp
- Paid MCP tools: https://agents.samedaydesk.com/mcp
- HTTP contracts: https://samedaydesk.com/openapi.json
- Skill: https://samedaydesk.com/skill.md
- API catalog: https://samedaydesk.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent card: https://samedaydesk.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Paid tool inventory and prices: https://agents.samedaydesk.com/.well-known/x402
- Public API documentation: https://samedaydesk.com/docs/x402-sdk/
- Guides, research and free generators: https://samedaydesk.com/resources.html

Ask the person before paying, or use a limit they set. Never retry a payment whose outcome is unknown. Keep passports, card numbers and passwords out of chat.
